name: Classical Greek
region: Greek world; narrow polis/region when strict
summary: Classical visual culture favors balanced human form, controlled movement and idealized naturalism, but actual Greek sculpture could be painted and should not default to “pure white timeless marble.”

wardrobe.text: draped garments such as chiton/himation in appropriate contexts; armor for warriors

architecture.text: stone temple/stoa/agora vocabulary must be site and date aware

weapons_tools.text: spear, shield, sword for appropriate martial context

writing_calligraphy.text: Greek inscriptions only when verified; avoid pseudo-Greek decorative text

visual_arts.text: contrapposto and balanced weight shift in free-standing figures
polychromy may be appropriate to sculpture

incompatible_or_anachronistic.text: Roman imperial cuirass portrait conventions labeled Classical Greek
pure-white marble asserted as original universal appearance

prompt_fragments.living: Create a living adult figure with Classical balance and material culture, not a marble statue unless the requested art method is sculpture.
prompt_fragments.sculpture: Use a coherent load-bearing stance, intentional contrapposto when appropriate, carved/cast surface logic and restrained evidence-aware color state.

scope_note: Foundation pack: use as a bounded starting point, not an encyclopedia.
strict_reconstruction_note: Strict mode should narrow city/region, date, civic/mythic role and archaeological/artwork evidence family.
